verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Mercury supports multiple purpose-named sub-accounts with auto-funding/transfer rules (mercury-comm-1), and docs/API reference a distinct 'Treasury' account type with its own transactions and statements (mercury-docs-12, mercury-probe-5), suggesting a yield-bearing cash-management vehicle. However, no evidence explicitly documents yield rates, FDIC/SIPC sweep mechanics, or a UI for configuring transfer thresholds/rules. Missing for 10: explicit high-yield rate disclosure, documented rule-configuration UI/API for automated transfers, and independent confirmation of yield performance.
